costs.uncertainty: Historical unknown usage and two unconfirmed dispatches remain. Cache-write usage is unknown. Cache reads are included in input; reasoning is included in output. No monetary bill was supplied.

limitations: Two single new candidate observations with historical references, not a randomized concurrent comparison or a new local-24 matrix.
Evaluator revisions, calendar time, dependency route and resource competition differ. Historical raw trajectories are unavailable for this audit; historical process counts remain missing.
No observed new OOM; historical candidate observations include 7 and 34 OOM events. A sampled memory peak alone does not prove OOM.
CompCert completed eleven blocking polls but spent 32.764 minutes in its initially interactive installation command before killing it. Low request frequency does not establish productive waiting.

Mailman archive is structurally valid but retains partial recording for two interrupted process-stream artifacts associated with service start/restart commands. All 39 requests and known input/output/cache/reasoning usage reconcile; this does not make every process stream complete.
Exact repeated whole-command count is not a semantic restart count. Commands changed log paths and parameters between diagnostic build retries.
